newsitem.title: USA: U.S. said not evacuating Americans from Albania.
newsitem.headline: U.S. said not evacuating Americans from Albania.

text.p: The United States has no plans to evacuate Americans from Albania and has not ordered a draw-down of its diplomatic staff there, the State Department said on Thursday.
"The U.S. ambassador (in Tirana) has not requested any kind of military assistance," spokesman Nicholas Burns told reporters.
Burns said there were no plans to withdraw U.S. diplomats from the country and "we're not planning right now an evacuation of American citizens."
U.S. military commanders in Germany reported earlier on Thursday that they were developing plans to evacuate more than 1,600 Americans living in Albania.

Burns welcomed Albanian President Sali Berisha's decision to suspend military action against armed insurgents in the south and said the United States hoped this would open the door to a broader political settlement of the crisis there, sparked by the collapse of financial pyramid schemes.
